title: Independent Semantic Critic & Blind Development Review

baseline.scope: original 44 development cases only; U3-B new 44 are excluded

timing.reason: U3-B generator is frozen; independent C0 results are required for C1 verification and explicitly authorized comparison

external_sources: Official public standard documentation only. No private raw names or records sent to unapproved third-party services. Record URL/version and evidence locator. Target IDs must exist in allowed local standard bytes.
forbidden_inputs: all non-allowlisted files except this protocol and configuration
all hidden candidate/score/rank files including ReviewCandidatesHidden.json and ReviewCandidatesHiddenRedSupplement.json
U3-B generator results, candidate pools, source code or output reports
other critic outputs, unblinding artifacts, Gold, indirect logs and recursive searches

review_task.batches: suggested 4 batches of 11; no case dropped
tasks: Source semantic reconstruction: base food, entity grain, food state, preparation, ingredients/composition, variety/species/edible part, region and unresolved dimensions; distinguish explicit source, semantic inference, external support and unresolved.
Bilingual expansion: Chinese/English preferred labels and aliases, broader concepts and required qualifiers; do not assert equivalent just from translation.
Independent target retrieval: up to 3 actually verified candidates per target standard; if no reliable candidate, retain unresolved. FNDDS carriers are the same cycle, not independent.
Directional judgment SOURCE_RELATION_TO_TARGET with reason, conditions, conflicts and evidence. Do not conflate food concept, recipe, product, measured instance or nutrient measurement.

Hard negative discovery: raw/cooked, fresh/frozen/dried, sweetened/unsweetened, salted/unsalted, peeled/unpeeled, processing, grain, regional variation, composition; retain relevant conflicting candidates.
Risk routing GREEN/AMBER/RED/HOLD as critic suggestion only; no formal acceptance.
review_task.evidence_required: Target system/version/native ID, native label, definition if available, source file/member/row or RDF locator and any authoritative supporting evidence. Do not invent IDs or target definitions.
review_task.exposure: Gemini previously audited U3-A implementation; declare possible historical exposure. Do not claim confirmatory strict blindness or scientific independence.

output.mode: NEW_DIRECTORY_ONLY; if already exists report status without overwrite

required.requirements: task_id, model/version or UNAVAILABLE, actual execution UTC, exact input paths and SHA256, actual access log, methods and exposure/violations
44 unique source-bound ReviewRecords, retain unresolved; validate output fields against review_task.record_fields
all actual candidates with verified native IDs, versions and locators
document actual conflicts, conditions and rationale; do not invent
Chinese Obsidian Markdown, counts and denominators, unresolved, risks, expert questions and limits; no independent accuracy/recall without independent reference
task_id, status, completion counts, SHA256 of other five files, input identities, model/version, unresolved/limitations, no unblinding and no release. Do not hash itself.

stop: Freeze only, stop, no unblinding or merge, no code change. On missing/mismatched inputs or failure record actual status HOLD and do not declare PASS.
controller_next: PI confirms frozen completion and separately authorizes C1 comparison; controller verifies first.
